unit: Algebra · Chapter 1. Power and exponential functions
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: The simplest exponential equation is aˣ = b: one solution if b > 0, none if b ≤ 0. Bring both sides to the same base.
stages.headlineEnglish: The simplest exponential equation is aˣ = b: one solution if b > 0, none if b ≤ 0. Bring both sides to the same base.

stages.headline: Substitution: 9ˣ − 4 · 3ˣ + 3 = 0. With t = 3ˣ > 0: t² − 4t + 3 = 0, t = 1 or 3, so x = 0 or 1.
stages.headlineEnglish: Substitution: 9ˣ − 4 · 3ˣ + 3 = 0. With t = 3ˣ > 0: t² − 4t + 3 = 0, t = 1 or 3, so x = 0 or 1.

stages.headline: Factor out the common power: 2^(x+1) + 2ˣ = 12 gives 2ˣ · 3 = 12, so 2ˣ = 4 and x = 2.
